subject: Post-call decisioning fit: eval pack, benchmarks & version guardrail
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria@finops.ai>, Sahil Mehta <sahil.mehta@finops.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call decisioning fit: eval pack, benchmarks & version guardrail

Thanks again for taking the time today — good discussion. Short recap + clear next steps so we stay aligned on fit and risk controls for the decisioning integration: 

Summary of needs we heard
- High recall on edge cases in chargeback detection (precision is important, but recall loss is higher risk)
- Consistent structured output (JSON fields: risk_score, root_cause, evidence_span)
- Tight latency SLAs for synchronous decisioning (95th percentile <= 420ms)

Redwood recommendations (first-pass)
- Candidate models to evaluate: rwd-v1-13b-instruct (good latency/cost), rwd-v1-70b-quant (higher quality for complex reasoning), mosaic-7b-instruct (fast baseline for A/B).
- Eval pack shared: labeled decisioning test suite + 60 example traces + prompt set (link below).
- Benchmarks we suggest running: structured-output exact match, schema F1, and recall-focused thresholds on your labeled fraud/chargeback set.

Links & artifacts
- Eval results template & instructions: https://redwood.app/evals/3421
- Prompt set & example prompts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-prompt-sets

Risk controls & rollout plan (recommended)
1) Start in shadow mode for 48-72h against production traffic to validate recall and structured outputs.
2) Canary the higher-quality model on 2% traffic with logging of all differences; gate by recall metric.
3) Pin the model version used in production (we recommend keeping a pinned fallback version for immediate rollback if a quality regression is detected).

Action items (owners)
- Logan (me): send eval pack & initial prompt set (attached) — today.
- Maria/Sahil: run the labeled tests against your top-2 candidates and share the top failure classes — by EOW.
- Neha/Rishi (ops & model onboarding): prep a version pin and a canary config scoped to FinOps.ai tenant — target Mon 11/16.

I'm attaching the prompt_set_v1.json and a baseline eval template. Happy to hop on another short call if you want to walk through the eval pack.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- prompt_set_v1.json (json)
- eval_template.md (txt)

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria@finops.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sahil Mehta <sahil.mehta@finops.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T18:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call decisioning fit: eval pack, benchmarks & version guardrail

Thanks Logan — this is great and aligned with what we discussed. Two quick items from our side: 

1) We ran a quick pass on last week's internal snapshot and noticed a drop in "root_cause" stability after your platform updated rwd-v1-13b to the 202610 build. I'll attach 8 failing examples where the root_cause field changed in ways that break our downstream rules.

2) Timeline: we can complete the labeled test run by Friday but we need an immediate mitigation for the regression — our compliance window is tight.

We attached a zip with sample outputs (examples.zip) and a small CSV with labels (eval_results.csv). Can you advise on the fastest way to pin to the previous version or run a quick A/B to show the delta to our team?

— Maria
Product Lead, Decisioning | FinOps.ai

Attachments:
- examples.zip (zip)
- eval_results.csv (csv)

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Maria Gonzalez <maria@finops.ai>
Cc: Sahil Mehta <sahil@finops.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Regression samples + emergency pin request — action plan

Neha / Rishi — forwarding Maria's examples. She observed a clear change after the 202610 build of rwd-v1-13b. Can you prioritize an emergency pin and a quick regression repro for FinOps.ai? Priority list below: 

Immediate (P0)
- Create an emergency pinned variant for FinOps.ai: rwd-v1-13b@20260921 (suggested fallback) and configure tenant routing to use the pinned variant ASAP. Confirm that pin is scoped to FinOps.ai (no global changes).
- Run a quick A/B (pinned vs current) on the 60 example traces Maria sent and produce a summary (delta table with exact match / schema F1 / recall).

Near-term (P1)
- Add a canary route at 2% with detailed logging and enable KV/prefix caching to ensure latency SLOs hold.
- If pinned variant shows better recall on the labeled set, schedule an ops-approved rollback window for production traffic once Maria confirms.

Operational notes
- We must preserve the existing model artifact and ensure hashes are auditable for compliance.
- If we cannot complete pinning within 4 business hours, we should open an expedited incident with Eng to throttle the model update rollout for FinOps.ai tenant only.

Maria — we'll treat this as an escalation and keep you updated every 2 hours until we have a pinned fallback and an A/B summary.

Thanks,
Logan

--- Forwarded attachment list ---
- examples.zip (zip)
- eval_results.csv (csv)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Maria Gonzalez <maria@finops.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Regression samples + emergency pin request — action plan

Confirming receipt and that ops will execute emergency pin for FinOps.ai. Planned timeline: 
- 11/16 12:00 PST: create tenant-scoped pin rwd-v1-13b@20260921 in staging and run A/B across submitted examples.
- 11/16 14:00 PST: push tenant routing to pinned variant in a controlled window (no global rollout).

I've opened Jira ticket SUP-90721 and uploaded the artifacts to the secure onboarding folder. We'll produce a quick delta CSV and a short slide (1-2 slides) showing the difference in schema F1 & recall for the failing classes Maria highlighted.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments placed in secure folder:
- /onboarding/finopsai/examples.zip
- /onboarding/finopsai/eval_results.csv

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria@finops.ai>, Sahil Mehta <sahil.mehta@finops.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fix in place: pinned fallback & A/B summary incoming

Maria / Sahil — quick update: 

- Ops created a tenant-scoped pin to rwd-v1-13b@20260921 and routed FinOps.ai traffic to the pinned variant at 11/16 14:05 PST. This affects only your tenant; global customers unchanged.
- We completed the A/B over your sample set; initial numbers show schema F1 improved from 0.71 -> 0.86 and recall on the labeled ‘‘root_cause’’ class improved ~12 points. Neha will share the delta CSV and a 2-slide summary in Jira SUP-90721.

Next steps for validation
- Maria: can you confirm by EOD today that the pinned variant meets your compliance checks? If yes, we'll keep the pin and proceed with the staged canary for 2% traffic for 72 hours as discussed.
- If you want an automated guard in the future, we can add a regression monitor that auto-triggers rollback when recall drops below agreed thresholds.

Thanks again for the speedy turnaround — looping Rishi for follow-up on the canary config.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Related links:
- Delta summary (will be attached to SUP-90721)
- Eval instructions: https://redwood.app/evals/3421
